metadata.description: 完整数字芯片设计流水线——16 个插件覆盖 15 个领域，从基础设施配置、设计实现到流片与固件，并支持 Verification↔RTL 闭环反馈。

plugins.name: chip-design-architecture
plugins.description: 微架构探索、PPA 估算、风险评估与 sign-off

plugins.name: chip-design-rtl
plugins.description: SystemVerilog RTL 设计——模块规划、编码规范、lint、CDC 与综合检查

plugins.name: chip-design-verification
plugins.description: UVM testbench、测试规划、约束随机、覆盖率收敛与 regression

plugins.name: chip-design-formal
plugins.description: 形式属性验证（FPV）与逻辑等价性检查（LEC）

plugins.name: chip-design-synthesis
plugins.description: 逻辑综合——SDC 约束、compile 优化、netlist QC 与 LEC

plugins.name: chip-design-dft
plugins.description: 可测性设计——scan insertion、ATPG、MBIST 与 JTAG boundary scan

plugins.name: chip-design-sta
plugins.description: 静态时序分析——multi-corner 分析、exception review 与 ECO guidance

plugins.name: chip-design-hls
plugins.description: 高层综合——C/C++ 到 RTL、directive 优化与 co-simulation

plugins.name: chip-design-soc
plugins.description: SoC IP 集成——IP 获取、bus fabric 与 chip-level simulation

plugins.name: chip-design-memory-ip
plugins.description: Memory IP 设计——SRAM/Register File/ROM macro 选择、array architecture、冗余修复、view 生成与 QA

plugins.name: chip-design-compiler
plugins.description: 编译器工具链——自定义 ISA 的 LLVM/GCC backend、assembler、linker 与 runtime library

plugins.name: chip-design-firmware
plugins.description: 嵌入式固件——BSP、外设驱动、RTOS 集成与验证

plugins.name: chip-design-fpga
plugins.description: FPGA 原型验证（FPGA emulation）——ASIC→FPGA 适配、partition、bring-up 与软件验证

plugins.name: chip-design-infrastructure
plugins.description: EDA 工具检测、日志过滤 wrapper、MCP Server 配置模板，以及所有芯片设计领域 Agent 的 Memory 蒸馏

plugins.name: chip-design-meta
plugins.description: 跨领域 Pipeline Orchestrator——通过 design_state.json fix_requests 驱动 Verification↔RTL 闭环，并在达到迭代上限时升级给用户
